Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Here is a proposal for you to review:

- Venue: the Studio, for your 10 people and 4 hours. It holds up to 12 people.
- Catering: one coffee break for every attendee.



| Item | Detail | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Studio (V1) | 4 hours | €240 |
| Coffee break (S1) | 10 people x €8 | €80 |
| **Total** | | **€320** |
| Budget | | €320 |
| Difference | | exactly on budget |



The total fits within your budget.

Assumption to check: you didn't mention accessibility, so I have assumed nobody needs wheelchair access. The Studio can only be reached by stairs. If anyone needs a route without stairs, please tell me. In that case we would look at the Loft, which is wheelchair accessible and holds up to 24 people.

Please also note:
- BrightRoom bookings are for 4 hours. There is no longer-duration option.
- Availability has to be checked separately for your date. Nothing is held at this stage.
- The listed prices are fixed.

Please get in touch if you'd like to adjust anything or go ahead with this proposal.

Kind regards

reasons: All stated requirements are met, subject to the listed assumptions.
assumptions: Accessibility not stated: assumed no wheelchair access is needed. The Studio is stairs-only.

checks.detail: one coffee break for every attendee

standing_notes: Only 4-hour bookings exist; there is no longer-duration price.
Dates always need a separate availability check; nothing is booked or held.
No discounts of any kind are available.
